# a_renamed_server_entry_keeps_its_name_when_its_taken_along_folder_is_discarded_again pins the filesystem.md rule that a second Discard takes along a server entry the user renamed in place and syncs only its new name.
# No other engine test renames an entry inside a taken-along folder before the second Discard, and the sim properties answer every question with one fixed answer, so they never reach a second Discard after a rename.
# a_server_folder_the_user_removed_an_entry_from_before_the_rules_left_it_out_is_not_taken_along pins cc 9f7f: a removal made before the rules exclude the entry, also across a restart. The existing excluded-entry tests only remove an entry the rules already exclude.
# a_file_removed_while_stopped_is_recorded_as_the_users_removal_by_the_scan_at_start proves the driver's scan at start records an offline removal; engine tests can't reach the driver's scan.
# a_store_from_before_removals_were_recorded_opens_with_none_recorded and the removed_from upgrade case cover the new migration, which the store's existing upgrade tests don't know.
